definitionZh: 弹性包装 CSS 属性设定是将弹性项目强制放在一条线上还是可以包裹到多条线上。 如果允许包装,它会设定线条堆叠的方向.
sourceDefinition: The flex-wrap CSS property sets whether flex items are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines. If wrapping is allowed, it sets the direction that lines are stacked.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The flex-wrap CSS property sets whether flex items are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines. If wrapping is allowed, it sets the direction that lines are stacked.
